node_definition.done_when: Done when. New tests, each failing at the base revision: A wait whose probe reports a live state is never overdue before its own declared or scheduler-known time limit. Any declared probe that answers counts as the wait's evidence, whatever its argv names, so a parked worker with such a probe is never read as abandoned. A probe naming a job that never started, with a cancelled state and zero elapsed time, is reported as a suspect probe on the run's row rather than as a terminal wait. The tests importing reckon.crew.recovery_liveness or reckon.crew.recovery_classification add no failure against the base on all_debug. Write paths: reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py , reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py , reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py , reckon/crew/recovery_wait.py (which owns the probe and expected-horizon readings) and a new test.
